source='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    separator = counts.most_common(2)[1][0]
    row_lines = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v == separator for v in row) > w / 2]
    col_lines = [c for c in range(w) if sum(grid[r][c] == separator for r in range(h)) > h / 2]
    if len(row_lines) < 2 or len(col_lines) < 2:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]

    nodes = [[background if grid[r][c] == separator else grid[r][c]
              for c in col_lines] for r in row_lines]
    out = []
    for i in range(len(row_lines) - 1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(col_lines) - 1):
            corners = (nodes[i][j], nodes[i][j + 1], nodes[i + 1][j], nodes[i + 1][j + 1])
            row.append(corners[0] if corners.count(corners[0]) == 4 else background)
        out.append(row)

    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(out) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != background]
    if not cells:
        return [[background]]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
    return [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in out[r0:r1 + 1]]
'''
file=programs/'task-3a4b72f9.py'
file.write_text(source)
print(file, file.exists())
